fr.title: Ce que disent nos passagers
fr.subtitle: Des milliers de voyageurs nous font confiance chaque jour

testimonials.name: Rakoto Jean
testimonials.comment: Service impeccable ! Le véhicule était confortable et propre, le chauffeur très professionnel. J'ai particulièrement apprécié la ponctualité du départ. Je recommande vivement Taxibrousse pour tous vos déplacements.

testimonials.name: Sarah Miller
testimonials.comment: As a tourist, I was impressed by the organization and safety measures. The driver was experienced and careful on difficult roads. The online booking system made everything so easy. Best transport option in Madagascar!

testimonials.name: Ravelo Andry
testimonials.comment: Très bon rapport qualité-prix. Le trajet Tana-Antsirabe s'est bien passé, avec une pause pratique à mi-chemin. Seul petit bémol, le départ a eu 20 minutes de retard, mais cela reste acceptable.

testimonials.name: Rasoamalala Nadia
testimonials.comment: Je voyage régulièrement avec Taxibrousse et je suis toujours satisfaite. Les chauffeurs sont courtois, les véhicules bien entretenus. Le programme de fidélité est un vrai plus !

testimonials.name: Pierre Dubois
testimonials.comment: J'ai effectué le trajet Tana-Tamatave en classe VIP. Quel confort ! Sièges inclinables, climatisation, prises USB... Je me suis senti comme en première classe. Le prix en vaut vraiment la peine.

testimonials.name: Randrianasolo Hery
testimonials.comment: Bon service dans l'ensemble. Le personnel à la gare était très serviable pour mes bagages un peu lourds. Le trajet était long mais le chauffeur a fait des pauses régulières. Merci !

en.title: What our passengers say
en.subtitle: Thousands of travelers trust us every day

testimonials.name: Rakoto Jean
testimonials.comment: Impeccable service! The vehicle was comfortable and clean, the driver very professional. I particularly appreciated the punctuality of the departure. I highly recommend Taxibrousse for all your travels.

testimonials.name: Sarah Miller
testimonials.comment: As a tourist, I was impressed by the organization and safety measures. The driver was experienced and careful on difficult roads. The online booking system made everything so easy. Best transport option in Madagascar!

testimonials.name: Ravelo Andry
testimonials.comment: Very good value for money. The Tana-Antsirabe trip went well, with a convenient break midway. The only minor downside was that the departure was 20 minutes late, but that's acceptable.

testimonials.name: Rasoamalala Nadia
testimonials.comment: I travel regularly with Taxibrousse and I'm always satisfied. The drivers are courteous, the vehicles well maintained. The loyalty program is a real plus!

testimonials.name: Pierre Dubois
testimonials.comment: I made the Tana-Tamatave trip in VIP class. What comfort! Reclining seats, air conditioning, USB ports... I felt like I was in first class. The price is really worth it.

testimonials.name: Randrianasolo Hery
testimonials.comment: Good service overall. The staff at the station was very helpful with my slightly heavy luggage. The trip was long but the driver made regular stops. Thank you!

mg.title: Izay lazain'ny mpandehanay
mg.subtitle: Mpanao dia an'arivony no matoky anay isan'andro

testimonials.name: Rakoto Jean
testimonials.comment: Serivisy tsy misy tsiny! Niadana ny fiara sady madio, ny mpamily dia matihanina be. Nankasitraka manokana ny fiaingana ara-potoana aho. Manolotsaina mafy an'i Taxibrousse ho an'ny dianao rehetra aho.

testimonials.name: Sarah Miller
testimonials.comment: Amin'ny maha mpizaha tany ahy, gaga aho tamin'ny fandaminana sy ny fepetra fiarovana. Ny mpamily dia za-draharaha sy malina tamin'ny làlana sarotra. Ny rafitra famandrihana an-tserasera dia nanamora ny zava-drehetra.

testimonials.name: Ravelo Andry
testimonials.comment: Tsara ny fifandanjana eo amin'ny vidiny sy ny kalitao. Nandeha tsara ny dia Tana-Antsirabe, nisy fialan-tsasatra mahasoa teo antenantenany. Ny mety tsy dia tsara fotsiny dia ny fiaingana tara 20 minitra, saingy azo ekena izany.

testimonials.name: Rasoamalala Nadia
testimonials.comment: Mandeha tsy tapaka miaraka amin'i Taxibrousse aho ary afa-po hatrany. Ny mpamily dia mahalala fomba, ny fiara dia kojakojaina tsara. Ny programa mahatoky dia tombony tena izy!

testimonials.name: Pierre Dubois
testimonials.comment: Nanao ny dia Tana-Tamatave tamin'ny kilasy VIP aho. Akory ny fahazoana aina! Seza azo ahinjitra, famangatsiahana, faka USB... Toy ny tao amin'ny kilasy voalohany aho. Mendrika tokoa ny vidiny.

testimonials.name: Randrianasolo Hery
testimonials.comment: Tsara ny serivisy amin'ny ankapobeny. Nanampy be ny mpiasa tao amin'ny toeram-piantsonana tamin'ny entako mavesatra kely. Lava ny dia fa nanao fialan-tsasatra tsy tapaka ny mpamily. Misaotra!
